issue.title: search_file_content returns no matches in ignored log directory despite both ignore filters disabled
issue.body:
## Observed behavior

During PR #3591 CI remediation on macOS, `search_file_content` returned no matches for a directory containing two 454 KB text logs with many matching lines. Both ignore-filter options were explicitly false.

Invocation:
```json
{"path":"/Users/acoliver/projects/llxprt/branch-1/llxprt-code/tmp/pr3591-lint-completion","pattern":"error|Error|FAIL|failed|EXIT|warning","file_filtering_options":{"respect_git_ignore":false,"respect_llxprt_ignore":false}}
```

Result: `No matches found`.

The directory contained `javascript-lint-job-101877140635.log` and `ci-lint-failed.log`. Reading the latter showed `##[warning]` lines, `ESLint found too many warnings (maximum: 0).`, `##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.`, and `EXIT_CODE=0`. The logs are captured from GitHub Actions run 34165998934, job 101877140635. A preceding directory listing also found the first log with the same ignore options.

## Expected behavior

Search the explicitly supplied directory when both ignore filters are disabled, or report the reason files were excluded rather than claiming no matches.

## Context

Checkout head: `3d06a0960e357eaa6653002797f938dd3b9fbf80`. The directory is under the repository's ignored `tmp/` tree. Root cause has not been established. No product changes were made for this issue.

steps: Initialize a Git repository, add tmp/ to .gitignore, and create tmp/pr3591-lint-completion/ci-lint-failed.log with exactly 10000 lines of ##[warning] ESLint found too many warnings and a final ##[error]Process completed with exit code 1. Create javascript-lint-job-101877140635.log in the same directory with the same text.

Use search_file_content with path="tmp/pr3591-lint-completion", pattern="error|Error|FAIL|failed|EXIT|warning", and file_filtering_options={"respect_git_ignore":false,"respect_llxprt_ignore":false}. Show the raw result.
expected: Explicitly disabled ignore filters permit search of the specified ignored logs, or the tool explains why it excludes them.
defect: The search tool says No matches found despite the supplied directory containing matching text logs.
Root cause: The issue establishes a mismatch between explicit ignore-filter options and search results, but does not establish the responsible code boundary. The private original logs are replaced by matching text of comparable size; no source-confirmed root cause is claimed.
